item.title: Cheongwadae: "Concerns over severe heatwave this year… All ministries to make utmost efforts to prevent casualties" (청와대 “올해 강한 폭염 우려…인명피해 없도록 전 부처 총력을”)
item.description:
On the 25th, Cheongwadae urged all ministries to make every effort to prevent preventable casualties from the heatwave. (청와대가 25일 전 부처에 폭염으로 예방 가능한 인명피해가 발생하지 않도록 총력을 다해달라고 당부했다.)

Cheongwadae held a meeting of senior secretaries chaired by Chief of Staff Kang Hun-sik that day, instructing the Ministry of the Interior and Safety to expand and early-operate cooling shelters, and the Ministry of Employment and Labor to inspect safety guidelines for outdoor workers and ensure thorough on-site management. Deputy Spokesperson An Gwi-ryung said in a written briefing that Kang stated at the meeting, "A heat-related death occurred on May 15, the earliest on record. This year, due to the influence of El Niño, a stronger heatwave than usual is feared." (청와대는 이날 강훈식 대통령비서실장 주재로 수석보좌관 회의를 개최하고, 행정안전부에는 냉방 쉼터 확대와 조기 운영을, 고용노동부에는 야외 작업자 안전지침 점검과 철저한 현장 관리를 주문했다. 강 실장은 이날 회의에서 “역대 가장 이른 시기인 지난 5월15일 온열질환 사망자가 발생했다. 올해는 엘니뇨의 영향으로 예년보다 더욱 강한 폭염이 우려된다”고 말했다고 안귀령 부대변인이 서면브리핑을 통해 전했다.)

Furthermore, Kang pointed out, "Despite illegal sports streaming sites and the distribution of digital sexual crimes materials recurring, the lack of fundamental solutions and mere stopgap measures have led to an increase in victims." Kang added, "Illegal sports streaming sites lure users with the bait of free viewing into illegal gambling, and reports of illegal sports gambling have exceeded 20,000 in 2024 alone. Since patchwork prescriptions can no longer protect the public, it is necessary to establish fundamental measures that change the structure itself." He then ordered the immediate formation of a task force from the civil affairs, social affairs, public relations and communication, and AI future planning senior secretariats to prepare and report practical and specific response measures. (아울러 강 실장은 “불법 스포츠 중계 사이트와 디지털 성범죄물 유포 문제가 반복되고 있음에도 근본적 해결책 없이 미봉책에 그쳐 피해자가 늘어나고 있다”고 지적했다. 강 실장은 이어 “불법 스포츠 중계 사이트가 무료 시청을 미끼로 이용자를 불법 도박으로 유인하고 있으며, 불법 스포츠 도박 신고가 2024년에만 2만 건을 넘었다”며 “땜질식 처방으로는 더 이상 국민을 보호할 수 없으니 구조 자체를 바꾸는 근본 대책 수립이 필요하다”고 덧붙였다. 그러면서 청와대 민정·사회·홍보소통·에이아이(AI)미래기획수석실에 태스크포스를 즉각 구성해 실질적이고 구체적인 대응 방안을 마련해 보고하라고 지시했다.)

By Seo Young-ji, Reporter yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: [Exclusive] Seoul City Held 17 Meetings with Ministry of Land…Zero Reports on ‘GTX Rebar Omission’ ([단독] 서울시, 국토부와 17번 회의…‘GTX 철근 누락’ 보고는 ‘0번’)
item.description:
It has been revealed that after Seoul City learned about the rebar omission construction accident in the Samsung Station section of the Great Train Express (GTX)-A line, it never once reported the rebar omission during a total of 17 meetings with the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport. While Seoul City shared even minor corrective measures such as ‘removing finishing tape’ and ‘reinforcing leak issues,’ the fact that it did not report the rebar omission has led to criticism that “it was a systematic cover-up to ‘save Oh Se-hoon.’” <<> According to data obtained by the office of Democratic Party lawmaker Yoon Geon-young, a member of the National Assembly’s Public Administration and Security Committee, from the Ministry of Land, there were a total of 17 meetings related to the construction work in which Seoul City participated, following November 10 of last year when Hyundai Engineering & Construction, the construction company for Samsung Station, reported the rebar omission to Seoul City. During this period, Seoul City is known to have not reported the rebar omission to the Ministry of Land even once. <<> In particular, the Ministry of Land’s position is that even at the interim inspection meeting held from November 25 to 27 of last year—the first meeting after Seoul City became aware of the rebar omission—“Seoul City did not disclose the rebar construction error, so the on-site inspection was conducted based on the original drawings.” During that inspection, the Ministry of Land, Seoul City, and others identified 50 corrective issues in six areas, and although they recorded minor corrective items such as the ‘need to remove finishing tape’ and ‘need to repair and reinforce ceiling cracks and leaks,’ the rebar omission was not reported. The same was true for the joint inspection held from January 12 to 15 of this year. At the ‘Samsung Station On-Site Inspection and 20th Progress Inspection Council’ meeting held on March 31, the director of the Ministry of Land’s Railroad Bureau mentioned the tunnel collapse accident on the Sinansan Line from last December due to design errors and urged ‘full attention to safety,’ but even on that day, Seoul City reportedly did not inform them of the rebar omission. <<> Lawmaker Yoon Geon-young told The Hankyoreh, “At numerous meetings, various topics related to Samsung Station were discussed, such as securing drainage functions and the need for additional consultation on evacuation route widths, but the complete lack of mention of the rebar, which is fundamental to structural safety, is proof that Seoul City is lying. This all shows that Seoul City is systematically covering up the issue to save Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party’s candidate for Seoul mayor.” <<> Meanwhile, Kim Seong-bo, the acting mayor of Seoul, held a briefing at Seoul City Hall that afternoon to announce ‘Seoul City’s Position on the Yeongdong-daero Complex Development Construction Project’ and stated, “After first sending the construction management report including details of the rebar omission to the National Railroad Corporation on November 13 of last year, we notified them of the progress of reinforcement reviews and detailed construction plans through six official documents up until the 24th of last month. (The Ministry of Land) is causing public anxiety. This is very regrettable.” <<> Reporter Chae-woon Kim cwk@hani.co.kr (서울시가 수도권광역급행철도(GTX)-에이(A) 노선 삼성역 구간 철근 누락 시공 사고를 알게 된 뒤, 국토교통부와 모두 17차례 회의를 하는 동안 철근 누락 사실을 단 한 번도 알리지 않은 것으로 드러났다. 서울시가 ‘마감테이프 제거’, ‘누수 보강’ 같은 세세한 보완사항까지 공유했으면서 정작 철근 누락 사실을 알리지 않은 걸 두고 “‘오세훈 구하기’를 위해 조직적으로 사안을 은폐한 것”이라는 지적이 나온다.)

item.title: Not even the Yoon Suk-yeol government used the 'North Korean main enemy' that the People Power Party demands as a preordained answer. (국힘이 ‘답정너’ 요구하는 ‘북한 주적’, 윤석열 정부도 안 썼다)
item.description:
The People Power Party is on the offensive, claiming that Democratic Party candidates running in the June 3 local elections and parliamentary by-elections failed to properly answer the question "Who is the main enemy of the Republic of Korea," and saying they "might as well run in North Korea." Park Seong-hoon, head of the Public Relations Team for the People Power Party's Central Election Committee, issued a commentary on the 25th targeting Democratic Party candidates Ha Jeong-woo (Busan North Gap by-election), Park Chan-dae (Incheon mayor candidate), and Kim Sang-wook (Ulsan mayor candidate), asserting that "These Democratic Party candidates can't even say North Korea is the main enemy" and that "the Democratic Party's distorted security awareness has been laid bare." (국민의힘이 6·3 지방선거와 국회의원 재보궐선거에 출마한 더불어민주당 후보들이 ‘대한민국 주적이 누구냐’는 질문에 제대로 답변하지 못한다며 “차라리 북한에서 출마하라”고 공세를 펴고 있다. 박성훈 국민의힘 중앙선대위 공보단장은 25일 논평을 내어 민주당의 하정우 부산 북갑 보궐선거 후보, 박찬대 인천시장 후보, 김상욱 울산시장 후보를 겨냥해 “북한이 주적이라고 말도 못 하는 민주당 후보들”이라며 “민주당의 왜곡된 안보 인식이 적나라하게 드러난 것”이라고 주장했다.)

The question "Who is the main enemy of the Republic of Korea," brought up by the People Power Party, is a preordained answer. Those asking this question of Democratic Party candidates firmly believe that "North Korea = main enemy." The Chosun Ilbo reported on this day in an article titled "Ruling party candidates can't answer 'who is the main enemy' question" as follows: (국민의힘이 꺼낸 ‘대한민국 주적이 누구냐’는 질문은 ‘답정너’(답은 정해졌으니까 너는 대답만 하면 돼)다. 이런 질문을 민주당 후보에게 하는 쪽은 ‘북한=주적’이라고 철석같이 믿고 있다. 조선일보는 이날 “‘주적은 누구’ 질문에 답 못하는 여당 후보들” 기사에서 이렇게 보도했다.)

"Ha Jeong-woo, the Democratic Party candidate for the Busan North Gap parliamentary by-election, did not answer when a YouTuber asked on the 22nd, 'Is North Korea the main enemy of the Republic of Korea?', responding 'Can you even ask this during an election campaign?' When pressed further, Candidate Ha replied, 'It's in the Defense White Paper.' In the Defense White Paper, the phrase designating North Korea as the main enemy was removed during the Moon Jae-in administration and reinstated during the Yoon Suk-yeol administration." (“부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거에 출마한 하정우 더불어민주당 후보는 지난 22일 한 유튜버가 ‘대한민국 주적이 북한이 맞느냐’고 묻자 ‘선거운동을 하는데 이렇게 물어도 되는 거냐’며 답하지 않았다. 계속되는 질문에 하 후보는 ‘국방부 백서에 나와 있다’고 답했다. 국방백서에선 북한을 주적으로 규정한 문구가 문재인 정부 때 삭제됐다가 윤석열 정부 때 다시 쓰여졌다.”)

This is an inaccurate report. Not only during the Roh Moo-hyun and Moon Jae-in administrations, when the Democratic Party was in power, but also during the Yoon Suk-yeol, Park Geun-hye, and Lee Myung-bak administrations, all led by the People Power Party, the Defense White Paper has never stated "North Korea is the main enemy." The term "North Korean main enemy" first appeared in 1995 and was used in the Defense White Paper until 2000. After that, governments stopped using the expression "North Korean main enemy" in the Defense White Paper. The term "North Korean main enemy" is a relic of the 20th century, abandoned in the 21st century. (사실과 다른 보도다. 민주당이 집권했던 노무현·문재인 정부뿐만 아니라 국민의힘이 집권했던 윤석열 정부, 박근혜 정부, 이명박 정부에서도 국방백서에 “북한은 주적”이라고 표기된 적이 없다. ‘북한 주적’은 1995년 처음 등장해 2000년까지 국방백서에 쓰였다. 이후 정부는 ‘북한 주적’ 표현을 국방백서에 사용하지 않고 있다. ‘북한 주적’ 표현은 21세기 들어 폐기된 20세기 유물이다.)

"North Korean main enemy" is neither an academic nor a military term. In March 1994, during working-level inter-Korean contacts for the exchange of special envoys at Panmunjom, a North Korean representative said, "If war breaks out, Seoul will turn into a sea of fire." The public was greatly angered by the so-called "Seoul sea of fire" remark, and in a retaliatory verbal salvo, the expression "North Korean main enemy" first appeared in the 1995 Defense White Paper the following year. It was a hastily coined term aimed at appeasing the inflamed domestic public opinion. (‘북한 주적’은 학술용어나 군사용어가 아니다. 1994년 3월 판문점에서 열린 남북 특사교환 실무접촉에서 북한 대표가 “전쟁이 일어나면 서울이 불바다가 되고 만다”고 말했다. 이른바 ‘서울 불바다’ 발언에 국민들이 크게 분노했고, 맞불 말폭탄으로 다음해인 1995년 국방백서에 “북한 주적”이란 표현이 처음 등장했다. 격앙된 국내 여론을 달래려는 급조된 용어였다.)

After the June 2000 inter-Korean summit, controversy arose domestically over the term "main enemy," and starting with the "2004 Defense White Paper" under the Roh Moo-hyun administration, the expression "North Korean main enemy" disappeared. It was replaced by terms such as "direct military threat" and "existing North Korean military threat." When the Lee Myung-bak administration took office in 2008, conservative circles demanded the revival of the "main enemy" expression in the Defense White Paper, but the "2008 Defense White Paper" used the phrase "direct and serious threat." Even after the Cheonan sinking incident in March 2010, there were strong conservative demands to "revive the main enemy," but the "2010 Defense White Paper" expressed it as "the North Korean regime and the North Korean military are our enemy." At that time, defense ministry officials stated, "It is not right to use the term 'main enemy' again and cause our society to fall into the inter-Korean conflict that North Korea wants" or "There are no cases of using the term 'main enemy' in defense white papers or similar official documents in other countries." The expression "the North Korean regime and the North Korean military are the enemy" was maintained until the Park Geun-hye administration. (2000년 6월 남북정상회담 이후 주적 표현을 두고 국내에서 논란이 일었고, 노무현 정부 때인 ‘2004 국방백서’부터는 ‘북한 주적’ 표현이 사라졌다. ‘직접적 군사위협’, ‘현존하는 북한의 군사적 위협’ 등으로 바뀌었다. 2008년 이명박 정부가 출범하자 보수 쪽에서 ‘국방백서에 주적 표현을 부활하자’는 요구가 나왔지만 ‘2008 국방백서’에서는 “직접적이고 심각한 위협”이라고 표현했다. 2010년 3월 천안함 사건 이후에도 보수 쪽의 강력한 ‘주적 부활’ 요구가 있었지만 ‘2010 국방백서’는 “북한 정권과 북한군은 우리의 적”으로 표현했다. 당시 국방부 당국자들은 “주적이란 표현을 다시 써서 우리 사회가 북한이 원하는 남남갈등에 빠지는 것은 옳지 않다”거나 “외국의 경우 국방백서나 이와 유사한 공식문서에 주적 표현 사례가 없다”고 했다. “북한 정권과 북한군은 적”이란 표현은 박근혜 정부 때까지 유지됐다.)

During the Moon Jae-in administration, in the 2018 and 2020 Defense White Papers, the enemy was not specifically identified as North Korea, but changed to "consider any force that threatens and infringes upon sovereignty, territory, citizens, and property as our enemy." (문재인 정부 때인 2018년과 2020년 국방백서에선 적을 북한으로 특정하지 않고 “주권, 국토, 국민, 재산을 위협하고 침해하는 세력을 우리의 적으로 간주한다”로 바뀌었다.)

Former President Yoon Suk-yeol posted on Facebook during his presidential campaign that "the main enemy is North Korea," but in the '2022 Defense White Paper', the first and last published by the Yoon Suk-yeol government, the term "main enemy" did not appear. It used the same expression as the Lee Myung-bak and Park Geun-hye administrations: "the North Korean regime and the North Korean military are the enemy." (윤석열 전 대통령은 대선 후보 시절 페이스북에 “주적은 북한”이란 글을 올렸지만, 윤석열 정부가 처음이자 마지막으로 발간한 ‘2022 국방백서’에는 ‘주적’ 표현이 등장하지 않았다. “북한 정권과 북한군은 적”이란 이명박·박근혜 정부 때 표현을 그대로 썼다.)

Almost no country officially uses the terms "main enemy" or "enemy" in defense white papers or similar government documents. This is because it narrows the room for strategic maneuver in foreign relations, harming national interests. The United States uses the term "threat." (국방백서나 유사한 정부 공식문서에 주적이나 적 표현을 공식적으로 사용하는 나라는 거의 없다. 대외관계에서 전략적 운신의 폭을 스스로 좁혀 국익을 해치기 때문이다. 미국은 ‘위협’(threat)’이라고 표현한다.)

In the international community, North and South Korea are almost unique in having used or using the concept of a "main enemy." In the past, South Korea used it for five years at the end of the 20th century, and currently, North Korea is the only one that uses it. Kim Jong-un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and Chairman of the State Affairs Commission, stated in his policy address on January 15, 2024, that "the Republic of Korea is our primary hostile state and invariable main enemy." On the 17th, he also convened an assembly of all military corps and division commanders, saying that "all military commanders and each level must continue to heighten class consciousness and main enemy consciousness, always remaining faithful to the sacred mandate of defending sovereignty in a state of high readiness." The surreal reality is that the People Power Party adheres to the concept of a main enemy, which Chairman Kim enjoys using. (국제사회에서 주적 개념을 사용했거나 사용하는 곳은 남북이 거의 유일하다. 과거 20세기 말 한국이 5년간 사용했고 현재 북한이 유일하게 사용한다. 김정은 조선노동당 총비서 겸 국무위원장은 지난 2024년 1월15일 시정연설에서 “대한민국은 철두철미 제1의 적대국, 불변의 주적”이라고 밝혔다. 지난 17일에도 전군 사·여단장 회의를 열어 “전군의 지휘관들과 각급이 계급의식, 주적의식을 계속 높이며 언제나 고도의 격동 상태에서 주권사수의 성스러운 본령에 충실해나가야 한다”고 했다. 김 위원장이 즐겨 사용하는 주적 개념을 국민의힘이 고수하는 현실이 초현실적이다.)

Reporter Kwon Hyeok-cheol nura@hani.co.kr (권혁철 기자 nura@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk Only Travels Between Yeongnam and Chungcheong (영남·충청만 누비는 장동혁)
item.description:
On the 25th, nine days ahead of the June 3 local elections, Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, visited Daegu for the third time this month. Instead of attending any election committee schedules or campaign support events in Seoul, where a tight race is unfolding, he has focused on multiple schedules in the Yeongnam and Chungcheong regions, interpreted as a sign of his determination to become a focal point for consolidating conservative support. <<> During a joint vision declaration ceremony for Daegu and North Gyeongsang Province held at the People Power Party's Daegu city party office that afternoon, Jang claimed, "Whenever President Lee Jae-myung and the Democratic Party open their mouths, they talk about integration and balanced regional development, but in reality, they are obsessed with dividing the regions." He further criticized, "They always implement policies that give people an inch but take a mile. Every policy exposes their incompetence and irresponsibility." Regarding Blue House Policy Chief Kim Yong-beom's comment the previous day on social media about high interest rates, high inflation, and high exchange rates being "friction noise for a leap forward," Jang stated, "We cannot entrust Daegu and North Gyeongsang to a regime and Democratic Party candidates who fail to understand the causes and offer proper measures." <<> Jang had previously attended the opening ceremonies of campaign offices for Daegu mayoral candidate Choo Kyung-ho and Daegu Dalseong by-election candidate Lee Jin-sook on the 3rd and 10th, respectively. After the vision declaration ceremony that day, he continued with a walking campaign along Suseong Lake in Daegu's Suseong District and then proceeded to a campaign event at the Saemaul Central Market in Gumi, North Gyeongsang Province. This contrasts sharply with the absence of any campaign activities in Seoul. Park Seong-hoon, spokesperson for the People Power Party's central election committee, told reporters that day, "This is a strategy to consolidate traditional conservative support and spread it nationwide," adding, "Chairman Jang plans to visit Seoul as well and will move in ways that benefit the candidates." <<> Through social media, Jang has been intensifying his criticism of the Lee administration daily. On Facebook that day, he posted a scene from the Netflix drama "Squid Game" with the caption "Please, come to your senses" and sarcastically wrote, "What has Lee Jae-myung done wrong? Even if he can't lower the exchange rate, he can lower store sales. Since interest rates have gone up, he'll raise house prices too. That's what a president should do—though I'm not sure which country's president he is." <<> By Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr <<> (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 6·3 지방선거를 9일 앞둔 25일, 이달 들어 세번째로 대구를 찾았다. 그는 박빙 승부가 펼쳐지는 서울에선 선거대책위원회 일정이나 지원 유세에 한번도 나서지 않은 대신, 영남권과 충청권 일정을 다수 소화하면서 보수 결집의 구심점이 되겠다는 의지를 보이는 것으로 해석된다.)

item.title: Jung Won-oh targets Yangcheon and Yeongdeungpo, the 'barometers of public sentiment', while Oh Se-hoon sweeps across Gangnam and Gangbuk (정원오 ‘민심 바로미터’ 양천·영등포 vs 오세훈 강남·강북 전방위 훑어)
item.description:
With nine days to go until the June 3 local elections, on the 25th, Jung Won-oh, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for Seoul Mayor, targeted Yangcheon, Yeongdeungpo, and Gangseo districts, often called the 'barometers' of Seoul's public sentiment. Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party candidate, conducted an all-out campaign aimed at citizens out for outdoor activities on the holiday. Jung hit out at Oh, citing the missing rebar at the GTX Samsung Station and blaming Oh's "safety insensitivity." Oh struck back, referencing delays in the completion of the Haengdang 7 district redevelopment and suspicions of a cartel involving the 'Seongdong Future Job Corporation' during Jung's tenure as Seongdong-gu chief, calling him "shameless." (6·3 지방선거를 9일 앞둔 25일, 정원오 더불어민주당 서울시장 후보는 서울 민심의 ‘바로미터’로 불리는 양천·영등포와 강서 지역을 공략했다. 오세훈 국민의힘 후보는 휴일을 맞아 야외 활동에 나선 시민들을 겨냥한 전방위 유세를 벌였다. 정 후보는 수도권광역급행철도(GTX) 삼성역 철근 누락 사태를 문제 삼으며 오 후보의 “안전불감증이 원인”이라고 직격했고, 오 후보는 정 후보의 성동구청장 재임 시절 ‘행당7구역 재개발 준공 지연’과 ‘성동미래일자리주식회사’ 카르텔 의혹 등을 언급하며 “후안무치”라고 날을 세웠다.)

Jung toured the Magongnaru Station and Seoul Botanic Park in Gangseo-gu, and a department store in Yangcheon-gu that morning, carrying out his campaign schedule. In the late afternoon, he held a focused rally at Times Square in Yeongdeungpo-gu, a high-traffic area. Yangcheon and Yeongdeungpo are considered indicators of Seoul's public sentiment, having shown vote shares in the 2022 Seoul mayoral election closest to the overall tally. At a rally in front of Hyundai Department Store Mokdong branch in Yangcheon-gu, Jung referenced the missing rebar incident, saying, "One of the main causes of the Sampoong Department Store collapse was rebar cut in half," and criticized Oh for "not even visiting the Samsung Station site even though it's been over 10 days since the poor construction was revealed in the media." (정 후보는 이날 오전 강서구 마곡나루역·서울식물원과 양천구 백화점 등을 돌며 유세 일정을 소화했다. 늦은 오후엔 유동인구가 많은 영등포구 타임스퀘어에서 집중 유세를 벌였다. 양천과 영등포는 서울 민심의 가늠자로 여겨지는 지역으로, 2022년 서울시장 선거에서 전체 득표율과 가장 근접한 수치를 나타낸 곳이다. 정 후보는 양천구 현대백화점 목동점 앞 유세 현장에서 철근 누락 사태를 언급하며 “삼풍백화점 붕괴 사고 주요 원인 중 하나가 철근 반 토막”이라며 “오 후보는 삼성역 부실시공이 언론에 밝혀진 지 10일이 넘게 지났음에도 현장에 가보지 않고 있다”고 꼬집었다.)

Since the official start of the campaign on the 21st, Jung has visited redevelopment and reconstruction sites in Nowon-gu, Jung-gu, Seodaemun-gu, Gwangjin-gu, Gangdong-gu, and Songpa-gu. On this day, he pledged to expedite the approval process for reconstruction in Yeongdeungpo-gu. In Gangseo-gu, he announced a transportation pledge for a '30-minute commute city Seoul' and promised to expand village buses and public shuttle buses, and to resume construction of stalled subway lines like the Mokdong Line and the Gangbuk Transversal Line. (정 후보는 지난 21일 공식 선거운동이 시작된 이후, 노원구·중구·서대문구·광진구·강동구·송파구 재개발·재건축 현장을 찾았다. 이날엔 영등포구에서 재건축 인허가 속도 단축을 공약했다. 또 강서구에서는 교통 공약인 ‘30분 통근도시 서울’을 발표하고 마을버스와 공공셔틀버스 확충, 목동선과 강북횡단선 등 중단된 전철 착공 등을 약속했다.)

Oh began his day promoting 'Seoul Tournomics' at the Seoul Hiking Tourism Center Gwanaksan branch in Gwanak-gu. The plan involves creating hiking tourism content leveraging Seoul's natural environment to stimulate the local economy. He then visited Dobongsan Mountain entrance in Dobong-gu and the Gyeongchun Line Forest Path in Nowon-gu to meet voters. In the afternoon, he visited Baehak Market and Jungang Market in Jung-gu, Seoul Children's Grand Park in Gwangjin-gu, and Gaepo Market in Gangnam-gu, and planned to wrap up his campaign by touring the Seongsu-dong Cafe Street in Seongdong-gu, considered Jung's political home. (오 후보는 이날 아침 관악구 서울등산관광센터 관악산점에서 ‘서울투어노믹스’ 띄우기에 나섰다. 서울의 자연환경을 활용한 등산 관광 콘텐츠를 만들고 지역경제를 활성화한다는 구상이다. 이어 도봉구 도봉산 입구, 노원구 경춘선숲길 등을 찾아 유권자들을 만났다. 오후에는 중구 백학시장·중앙시장, 광진구 어린이대공원, 강남구 개포시장 등을 잇달아 찾았고, 정 후보의 정치적 고향이라 할 수 있는 성동구 성수동 카페거리 등을 돌며 유세를 마무리할 예정이다.)

After his rally at Seoul Children's Grand Park in Gwangjin-gu, Oh met with reporters and criticized Jung's response about the delay in the completion of the Haengdang 7 district redevelopment, saying it was framed as a difficulty in meeting the deadline. "Is that a normal market sense or responsible administration?" Oh asked. "It's not something a mayor who is supposed to take responsibility for 10 million people should say." Referring to allegations that six close aides participated as equity investors in the 'Seongdong Future Job Corporation' established during Jung's time as Seongdong-gu chief, Oh said, "They created a legal mechanism for the Democratic Party to make jobs and distribute money among their own, to their own aides" and called it "'Park Won-soon Season 2'." Jung's campaign responded, explaining, "Seongdong Future Jobs was operated transparently and fairly for public purposes, and has nothing to do with the district chief taking care of close aides." (오 후보는 광진구 어린이대공원 유세 뒤 기자들과 만나 정 후보가 행당7구역 재개발 준공 지연에 대해 ‘준공 기간을 맞추기 어렵다’는 취지로 답변한 것을 두고 “정상적 시장감인가, 책임감 있는 행정인가”라며 “인구 1천만을 책임지겠다는 시장이 할 말이 아니다”라고 했다. 또 정 후보가 성동구청장 재직 시절 설립한 ‘성동미래일자리주식회사’에 측근 6명이 지분 투자자로 참여했다는 의혹을 제기하면서는 “민주당 일자리를 만들고 민주당 관계자들, 자기 측근들에게 돈을 나누어 주는 합법적인 장치를 마련한 것”이라며 “‘박원순 시즌2’라는 말씀을 드리는 것”이라고 비판했다. 이에 대해 정 후보 캠프는 “성동미래일자리는 공익적 목적으로 투명하고 공정하게 운영됐으며, 구청장의 측근 챙기기와는 아무런 관련이 없다”고 해명했다.)

Regarding Democratic Party lawmaker Park Min-kyu's press conference on the rebar omission incident, where Park alleged that "on November 10 last year, the day after Hyundai Engineering & Construction officially reported the missing rebar to the Seoul Metropolitan Government, Oh conveyed instructions regarding underground construction matters to various departments, but key safety issues like the missing rebar were left out," suggesting a cover-up, Oh dismissed it outright, saying, "I was never informed." (오 후보는 이날 박민규 민주당 의원이 기자회견을 열어 철근 누락 사태와 관련해 “현대건설이 서울시에 철근 누락 사실을 공식 보고한 지난해 11월10일 다음날, 오 후보가 (전 부서에 내려가는) 지하화 공사 관련 지시 사항을 전달했으나 철근 누락과 같은 핵심 안전 문제는 빠져 있었다”며 은폐 의혹을 제기한 데 대해서는 “보고받은 사실이 전혀 없다”고 일축했다.)

Reporter Ko Kyung-ju goh@hani.co.kr Reporter Jang Na-rae wing@hani.co.kr (고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr 장나래 기자 wing@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Sweeping through Daegu and Chungcheong, then Busan-Ulsan-Gyeongnam and Gangwon... Impeached Park Geun-hye at the forefront of People Power Party campaign (대구·충청 훑고 부울경·강원까지…탄핵당한 박근혜, 국힘 유세 전면에)
item.description:
Former President Park Geun-hye is making her presence felt by appearing at the forefront of the June 3 local elections. Following a campaign rally at Daegu Chilsung Market on the 23rd, she toured the Chungcheong region on the 25th to support candidates, and has a string of schedules lined up in Busan, Ulsan, Gyeongnam (BUGyeongnam), and even Gangwon. The Democratic Party of Korea criticizes this, saying, "Not content with Yoon Again, now it's Park Again?" (박근혜 전 대통령이 6·3 지방선거 전면에 등장하며 존재감을 과시하고 있다. 지난 23일 대구 칠성시장 유세에 이어 25일엔 충청 지역을 돌며 후보자들을 지원했고 부산·울산·경남(부울경)과 강원까지 줄줄이 일정이 예고돼 있다. 더불어민주당에선 “윤 어게인도 모자라 박 어게인이냐”는 비판이 나온다.)

On the morning of this day, former President Park Geun-hye spent about 20 minutes visiting the birthplace of her mother, Yuk Young-soo, in Okcheon, North Chungcheong Province, along with Chungbuk Governor candidate Kim Young-hwan and Okcheon County Governor candidate Jeon Sang-in. She then said, "If (the candidates) give the people the belief that they will keep their promises, the people will recognize them and make their choice." ( 박근혜 전 대통령은 이날 오전 충북 옥천에 있는 모친 육영수 여사의 생가를 김영환 충북지사 후보와 전상인 옥천군수 후보 등과 20여분간 둘러본 뒤 “(후보들이) 약속한 것은 지킨다는 이런 믿음을 주시면 국민께서 알아주시고, 선택하실 것”이라고 말했다.)

Subsequently, former President Park visited the election office of Daejeon Mayor candidate Lee Jang-woo and had a private discussion with him for about 20 minutes. Former President Park appealed for support, stating, "Candidate Lee is a comrade who has been with me for many years, a consistent person who, no matter how difficult the situation, remains unwavering and keeps faith." In Gongju Saneong Market, South Chungcheong Province, she provided support fire for South Chungcheong Governor candidate Kim Tae-heum. Former President Park plans to continue her nationwide wide-ranging schedule, visiting Jinju, South Gyeongsang Province on the 27th, followed by Ulsan and Busan, and then Wonju, Gangwon Province on the 28th. These appearances are reportedly all in response to requests from the candidates for support. <<> Former President Park served 4 years and 9 months in prison after the Supreme Court finalized her sentence of 22 years in prison, a fine of 18 billion won, and an additional levy of 3.5 billion won for charges including the "Rasputin" national affairs abuse scandal and the provision of special activity funds to the National Intelligence Service. She was released in December 2021 following a special pardon by former President Moon Jae-in. This is the first time former President Park has appeared at a campaign rally since her impeachment. <<> Within the party, concerns and expectations are mixed. A first-term lawmaker told The Hankyoreh, "I wonder if only seeing former President Park will help expand the moderate base," but also added, "Although she is an impeached president, there is a sentiment that it's still better for consolidating the conservative vote than Representative Jang Dong-hyuk and 'Yoon Again'." <<> On the other hand, Kim Young-ho, a lawmaker and co-chair of the joint election committee for Democratic Party Seoul Mayor candidate Jeong Won-oh, criticized, "Producing two former presidents who were impeached and removed through the people's judgment, and then, instead of reflecting, bringing those names back to the forefront of politics is an insult to the people." Kim Yong-min, a lawmaker and secretary of the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee, also said, "It is abnormal and a disregard for the people that national affairs abuser Park Geun-hye and insurrectionist Choo Kyung-ho are appearing together." <<> Reporters: Jang Narae wing@hani.co.kr, Ko Hansol sol@hani.co.kr, Yoo Youngjae young@hani.co.kr ( 이어 이장우 대전시장 후보 선거사무소를 찾은 박 전 대통령은 이 후보와 20여분간 비공개 차담을 나눴다. 박 전 대통령은 “이 후보는 저와 오랜 세월 함께한 동지이자 아무리 어려운 일이 닥쳐도 흔들림 없이 신의를 지키는 한결같은 사람”이라며 지지를 호소했다. 충남 공주 산성시장에선 김태흠 충남지사 후보를 지원 사격했다. 박 전 대통령은 오는 27일 경남 진주에 이어 울산과 부산을 차례로 찾고, 28일엔 강원 원주를 방문하는 등 전국구 광폭 행보를 이어갈 예정이다. 모두 후보들의 지원 요청에 따른 것이라고 한다.)

item.title: Close Race in South Chungcheong... Democratic Party Deploys Two Top Figures, People Power Party Backed by Park Geun-hye (충남 초박빙에…투톱 출동한 민주, 박근혜 세운 국힘)
item.description:
On the 25th, nine days ahead of the June 3 local elections and parliamentary by-elections, the ruling and opposition parties mobilized en masse in the Chungcheong region, a perennial swing-vote area during elections, for intensive campaigning. In particular, South Chungcheong initially saw the Democratic Party of Korea taking the lead in early polls, but the People Power Party has recently closed the gap, making it a fiercely contested battleground. (6·3 지방선거 및 국회의원 재보궐선거를 9일 앞둔 25일, 여야가 선거 때마다 캐스팅보트 지역으로 꼽히는 충청권에 총출동해 집중 유세에 나섰다. 특히 충남은 선거 초기 더불어민주당이 앞서가는 판세였지만, 최근 국민의힘이 바짝 추격하며 격전지로 꼽히고 있다.)

On this afternoon, Democratic Party leader Jeong Cheong-rae and floor leader Han Byeong-do hit the campaign trail in South Chungcheong. Jeong visited Seocheon and Boryeong, urging voters to elect Park Su-hyeon as the South Chungcheong governor, saying, "Shouldn't the president and the South Chungcheong governor both be from the Democratic Party for seamless coordination?" Han Byeong-do attended a field meeting at Park's campaign office, where he stated, "The Democratic Party will provide full legislative support for a special act on the administrative integration of South Chungcheong and Daejeon, granting exceptional fiscal privileges to the integrated local government." Han also toured other areas in South Chungcheong, including Nonsan and Asan, to campaign. (이날 오후 더불어민주당 정청래 대표와 한병도 원내대표는 충남지역 지원 유세에 나섰다. 정 대표는 충남 서천과 보령을 방문해 “대통령도 민주당, 충남도지사도 민주당이어야 손발이 맞아들어가지 않겠냐”며 박수현 충남지사 후보를 뽑아달라고 했다. 한 원내대표는 박 후보 선거사무소에서 열린 ‘충남·대전 행정통합 및 핵심 현안 지원을 위한 현장 간담회’에 참석해 “민주당은 충남·대전 행정통합 특별법에 대한 전폭적인 입법 지원을 통해 통합 지방자치단체에 파격적 재정 특례를 부여할 것”이라고 말했다. 한 원내대표는 이날 논산과 아산 등 충남 지역을 돌며 지원 유세를 했다.)

People Power Party floor leader Song Eon-seok toured Dangjin, Gongju, and Cheonan in South Chungcheong to support candidate Kim Tae-heum for governor. Former President Park Geun-hye also joined the South Chungcheong campaign, following her support for People Power Party Daegu mayoral candidate Choo Kyeong-ho on the 23rd. On this morning, Park visited the birthplace of Yuk Yeong-su in Okcheon, North Chungcheong, to meet with North Chungcheong Governor candidate Kim Yeong-hwan and Okcheon County candidate Jeon Sang-in. She later visited Daejeon, encouraging Daejeon mayoral candidate Lee Jang-woo at his campaign office, before accompanying candidate Kim Tae-heum at the Gongju Seongsi Market campaign event. Park stated, "I have a long-standing relationship with Candidate Kim. In difficult times, proven leadership is essential." (송언석 국민의힘 원내대표는 이날 충남 당진과 공주, 천안을 돌며 김태흠 충남지사 후보를 지원 사격했다. 박근혜 전 대통령도 지난 23일 추경호 국민의힘 대구시장 후보 지원에 이어 충남지역 유세에 나섰다. 박 전 대통령은 이날 오전 충북 옥천 육영수 여사 생가를 방문해 김영환 충북지사 후보와 전상인 옥천군수 후보를 찾았다. 이어 대전을 찾아 이장우 대전시장 후보 선거사무소를 격려 방문한 뒤 충남 공주시 산성시장을 찾아 김태흠 후보 유세에 동행했다. 박 전 대통령은 “김 후보와 오랜 인연이 있다. 어려운 시기일수록 검증된 리더십이 필요하다”고 말했다.)

In the South Chungcheong gubernatorial race, early polls showed Park leading by over 10 percentage points, suggesting a ruling party advantage, but Kim has rapidly closed the gap, leading to a tight contest within the margin of error. A telephone survey conducted by KBS Daejeon and Korea Research from the 16th to the 20th recorded Park at 41% and Kim at 37% in approval ratings (for details, refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission website). The Democratic Party and People Power Party view the South Chungcheong gubernatorial election as a close race. (충남지사 선거는 선거 초반 여론조사에서 박 후보가 10%포인트 이상 앞서며 여당 우세로 전망됐지만, 김 후보가 빠르게 추격하며 오차범위 내 초접전을 벌이고 있다. 지난 16~20일 이뤄진 한국방송(KBS)대전·한국리서치 전화면접 조사에서 박 후보는 41%, 김 후보는 37%의 지지율을 기록했다.(자세한 사항은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 누리집 참조) 민주당과 국민의힘은 충남지사 선거를 ‘경합’으로 보고 있다.)

item.title: Lee Yong-joon, Sejong Institute Chairman Who Brought in Gordon Chang Advocating Insurrection, Denied Reappointment (‘고든 창 불러 내란 옹호’ 이용준 세종연구소 이사장 연임 불승인)
item.description:
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced on the 25th that it did not approve the reappointment of Lee Yong-joon as chairman of the Sejong Institute. Chairman Lee is a figure who sparked controversy by revealing political bias, including inviting a far-right American figure who defended former President Yoon Suk-yeol's attempt at martial law. (외교부가 이용준 세종연구소 이사장 연임을 승인하지 않았다고 25일 밝혔다. 이용준 이사장은 윤석열 전 대통령의 계엄 시도를 옹호하는 미국 극우인사를 초청하는 등 정치적 편향성을 드러내 논란이 됐던 인물이다.)

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated, "The Sejong Institute foundation requested approval for Chairman Lee's reappointment on the 21st, and after a thorough review in accordance with relevant laws and regulations, the Ministry notified on the 22nd that it would not approve Chairman Lee's reappointment." The Sejong Institute is a research institution in the fields of diplomacy and security under the supervision of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and the approval of its executives falls under the Ministry's authority. (외교부는 “재단법인 세종연구소가 지난 21일 이 이사장 연임 승인을 해 줄 것을 요청해왔고, 외교부는 관련 법령에 따라 면밀히 검토한 뒤 이 이사장의 연임을 불승인한다는 입장을 22일 통보했다”고 이날 밝혔다. 세종연구소는 외교부 감독을 받는 외교·안보 분야 연구기관으로, 세종연구소의 임원 승인은 외교부 권한이다.)

On the 18th, the Sejong Institute board of directors decided by an 8-to-5 vote to reappoint Chairman Lee, subsequently requesting approval from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. However, since the Sejong Institute was founded in 1983, there has never been a case of a chairman being reappointed. (지난 18일 세종연구소 이사회는 이 이사장의 연임을 8대5로 결정한 뒤 외교부에 연임 승인을 요청했다. 그러나 1983년 세종연구소가 출범한 이래 이사장이 연임한 사례는 한 번도 없었다.)

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated that approval of Sejong Institute executives is "a unique authority of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs" and that "even if a person does not fall under the disqualification criteria stipulated in the Act on the Establishment and Operation of Public Interest Corporations, it does not mean their appointment must be automatically approved; the supervising ministry has discretion." However, regarding the specific reasons for denying his reappointment, the Ministry stated, "It is a matter related to personal information, so it is difficult to disclose." (외교부는 세종연구소 임원 승인은 “외교부의 고유 권한”이라며 “공익법인법에서 정한 결격사유에 해당하지 않는다고 하여 임원 취임을 당연히 승인해야 하는 것이 아니며, 감독부처로서의 재량이 있다”고 했다. 다만 그의 연임을 불승인한 구체적인 사유에 대해선 “개인 신상과 관련된 사항이므로 공개하기 곤란하다”고 밝혔다.)

Chairman Lee, a former diplomat who served as Vice Minister of Foreign Affairs and Trade during the Lee Myung-bak administration, was appointed in June 2023 under the Yoon Suk-yeol administration. At that time, former Chairman Moon Chung-in, appointed during the Moon Jae-in administration, still had a year left in his term. However, as the Ministry of Foreign Affairs pressured the institute, including conducting an audit, former Chairman Moon resigned mid-term. (외교관 출신으로 이명박 정부 시절 외교통상부 차관보를 지낸 이 이사장은 윤석열 정부 때인 2023년 6월 임명됐다. 당시엔 문재인 정부 시절 임명된 문정인 전 이사장이 임기를 1년이나 남겨두고 있었다. 그러나 외교부가 연구소 감사를 벌이는 등 압박을 가하면서 문 전 이사장은 중도에 사임했다.)

Meanwhile, Chairman Lee also drew attention last year when he officially invited Gordon Chang, a far-right American figure, to the Sejong National Strategy Forum on April 3, the day before the Constitutional Court's impeachment trial of former President Yoon Suk-yeol. Gordon Chang, who alleges election fraud, defended former President Yoon at the time, stating, "If President Yoon is impeached, the South Korea-U.S. alliance will be weakened." (한편 이 이사장은 윤석열 전 대통령 헌법재판소의 탄핵심판 전날인 지난해 4월3일 세종국가전략포럼에 미국 극우인사 고든 창을 공식 초청해 입길에 오르기도 했다. 부정선거를 주장하는 고든 창은 당시 “윤석열 대통령이 탄핵되면 한-미 동맹이 약화된다”며 윤 전 대통령을 옹호하기도 했다.)

The term for the Sejong Institute chairman is three years, and Chairman Lee's term ends on the 31st of this month. (세종연구소 이사장 임기는 3년으로, 이 이사장의 임기는 오는 31일 끝난다.)

Jang Ye-ji Reporter penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk's First Seoul Campaign Support Draws Cold Shoulder from Some Candidates: "Not Helpful" (장동혁 첫 서울 지원 유세에…일부 후보들 “도움 안돼” 난색)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, has decided to embark on his first campaign support trip to Seoul since the official start of the June 3 local elections. However, he will not accompany Oh Se-hoon, the party's mayoral candidate for Seoul, and there is growing pushback from local districts, with some claiming his appearances "do not help the election." (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 6·3 지방선거 공식 선거운동이 시작되고 처음으로 서울 지원 유세에 나서기로 했다. 하지만 오세훈 서울시장 후보 유세에는 동행하지 않는데다 지역에서도 “선거에 도움이 되지 않는다”는 반발이 나오고 있다.)

On the afternoon of the 26th, Rep. Jang plans to visit Geumnam Market in Seongdong-gu with Go Jae-hyun, the party's candidate for Seongdong-gu mayor, followed by a campaign walk along the Gyeongui Line Forest Park in Mapo-gu and a stroll through the Southern Alley Market in Gangseo-gu. (장 대표는 26일 오후 고재현 서울 성동구청장 후보와 함께 성동 금남시장을 찾는 것을 시작으로 마포 경의선숲길 유세 및 도보유세, 강서 남부골목시장 도보유세 등을 진행한다.)

These schedules were reportedly arranged by the party leader's office through direct contact with district office candidates, without consulting the Seoul city party branch. A Seoul city party official, in a phone call with *The Hankyoreh* on the 25th, stated, "There was no consultation at all—not just with the Seoul city party, but also with the relevant district party chairs." The official added, "The candidates themselves are expressing reluctance, and although the city party has conveyed strong concerns, Rep. Jang is unilaterally pushing ahead with the schedule." Another district party chair in Gangseo-gu remarked, "There was absolutely no discussion with the leader's office, and the district office candidate wasn't even aware until lunchtime that day. Would this actually help the candidates?" An official from Oh Se-hoon's camp also commented, "This schedule is unrelated to Candidate Oh." (해당 일정은 서울시당과 협의 없이 당대표실에서 개별적으로 구청장 후보를 접촉해 이뤄진 것으로 알려졌다. 서울시당 관계자는 25일 한겨레와 한 통화에서 “서울시당뿐 아니라 해당 당협위원장과도 협의가 전혀 없었다”며 “후보자들도 난색을 표하고 있어 시당 차원에서 강한 우려를 전달했는데도 장 대표가 일방적으로 일정을 강행하고 있다”고 반발했다. 강서구의 한 당협위원장도 “당대표실에서 전혀 협의조차 없었고, 구청장 후보도 이날 점심까지도 전혀 모르고 있었다”며 “후보들에게 도움이 되겠나”라고 했다. 오세훈 후보 쪽 관계자도 “오 후보와는 관련 없는 일정”이라고 했다.)

In response, an official from the leader's office stated, "The schedule was arranged at the request of local candidates," and added, "Candidate Oh did not make a request, so we are not accompanying him." (이에 대표실 관계자는 “지역 후보들의 요청에 의해서 일정을 잡은 것”이라며 “오 후보는 요청이 없어 동행하지 않는 것”이라고 밝혔다.)

Rep. Jang visited Daegu for the third time this month on this day. This is interpreted as an effort to solidify his role as a unifying figure for the conservative base, as he handles numerous schedules in the Yeongnam and Chungcheong regions. In the afternoon, Jang attended a joint vision declaration ceremony for Daegu and North Gyeongsang Province at the People Power Party's Daegu city party office, where he claimed, "President Lee Jae-myung and the Democratic Party talk about unity and balanced regional development whenever they open their mouths, but in reality, they are focused on dividing regions." Regarding Kim Yong-beom, head of the Cheong Wa Dae policy office, who had posted on social media the previous day that high interest rates, high inflation, and high exchange rates were "a friction sound for a leap forward," Jang said, "We cannot entrust Daegu and North Gyeongsang Province to an administration and Democratic Party candidates who fail to understand the causes and cannot come up with proper measures." (장 대표는 이달 들어 세번째로 이날 대구를 찾았다. 영남권과 충청권 일정을 다수 소화하면서 보수 결집의 구심점이 되겠다는 의지를 보이는 것으로 해석된다. 장 대표는 이날 오후 국민의힘 대구시당에서 열린 대구·경북 공동 비전 선포식에 참석해 “이재명(대통령)과 더불어민주당이 입만 열면 통합과 지역 균형 발전을 이야기하지만 실제로는 지역 갈라치기에 몰두하고 있다”고 주장했다. 김용범 청와대 정책실장이 전날 에스엔에스에 고금리·고물가·고환율에 대해 “도약하기 위한 마찰음”이라고 한 데 대해서는 “원인도 파악하지 못하고 제대로 된 대책도 내놓지 못하는 정권과 민주당 후보에게 대구와 경북을 맡길 수는 없다”고 말했다.)

Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr Jang Na-rae Correspondent wing@hani.co.kr (유영재 young@hani.co.kr 장나래 기자 wing@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae Says, "If You Like President Lee, Vote for Lee Won-taek"... Ruling Party Leadership Heads to 'Very Close' Jeonbuk (정청래 “이 대통령 좋아한다면 이원택”…여당 지도부 ‘초박빙’ 전북 달려가)
item.description:
The leadership of the Democratic Party visited Jeonbuk on the 25th to launch a full-scale campaign rally for Lee Won-taek, the party's candidate for Jeonbuk governor in the June 3 local elections. This comes after Kim Gwan-young, who was expelled from the party over suspicions of "cash payments for proxy voting," entered the race as an independent, leading to a tight contest. The party has gone on the offensive to "hold onto Jeonbuk." The outcome of the Jeonbuk gubernatorial election could become a variable for the August party convention, where Representative Jung Cheong-rae may seek a second term, putting the party on high alert. <<> Representative Jung held an on-site central election committee meeting at the campaign office of Lee Hak-soo, the candidate for mayor of Jeong-eup, and said, "If you like and support President Lee Jae-myung, please vote for Democratic Party candidate Lee Won-taek." He added, "If we make Lee Won-taek the Jeonbuk governor, the party, government, and administration will become a united team and give our all with sincerity to improve the lives of Jeonbuk residents, such as through the development of Saemangeum." Additionally, Jung directly criticized Kim's recent claim on a broadcast that he had "informed the president about the inevitability of running as an independent," calling it "a serious dissemination of false information. It's a dangerous gamble that puts the president in a difficult spot." <<> Participants in the election committee, including floor leader Han Byeong-do, also poured out harsh criticism toward Kim. Floor leader Han stated, "Kim claims there was 'political interference in nominations,' but that's a rumor to open up his own political path. The essence of his disqualification as a candidate is the cash distribution." Kim asserts that the nomination of Lee, known as a member of the 'pro-Jung faction,' constitutes such interference. <<> With nine days left until the election, the Democratic Party leadership's mass mobilization to Jeonbuk, rather than to battlegrounds in Seoul and Busan-Ulsan-Gyeongnam (where they face close contests with People Power Party candidates), is due to the extremely tight race for Jeonbuk governor. In a poll conducted by KBS Jeonju and Embrain Public from the 18th to the 20th via wireless phone interviews, Lee garnered 39% and Kim 37%. In a CBS-KSOI poll from the 23rd to the 24th using wireless ARS, Lee received 40% and Kim 44.1%. (For details, refer to the website of the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission.) <<> A neck-and-neck race between a Democratic Party candidate and an independent in the Jeonbuk gubernatorial election is unusual. Since the first direct election in 1995, candidates affiliated with the Democratic Party have consistently won the Jeonbuk governor seat. Analysts suggest that Jeonbuk has become a battleground because, in addition to Kim's incumbent premium, the race is shaping up as a "Jung Cheong-rae vs. Kim Gwan-young" contest rather than a "Lee Won-taek vs. Kim Gwan-young" one. This means Kim is gaining ground by riding on the sentiment of resistance against Jung's nominations in the Honam region. Kim said on a radio broadcast today, "Kim Gwan-young's victory will trigger Jung Cheong-rae's resignation." Kim's camp also issued a commentary criticizing the Jeonbuk party chapter's decision to initiate disciplinary proceedings against three party members assisting Kim, calling it "selective punishment aimed at isolating Kim." <<> The Democratic Party's anxiety is further fueled by the fact that its candidates for basic local government heads in areas like Suncheon, Gangjin, Shinan, Hampyeong, Damyang, and Wando in Jeonnam are struggling against candidates from progressive opposition parties and independents. There is a view that Jung's seven visits to Honam this month (excluding the May 18 Gwangju Democratization Movement commemoration) are not unrelated to this situation. A lawmaker from Honam said, "Regardless of the outcome of the Jeonbuk gubernatorial election, the current situation where a crack in the Honam public sentiment is evident is already becoming a variable in Representative Jung's bid for a second term. He will have no choice but to give his all until election day." <<> Reporter Go Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr (더불어민주당 지도부가 25일 전북을 찾아 6·3 지방선거 이원택 전북지사 후보에 대한 대대적인 지원 유세에 나섰다. ‘대리비 현금 지급’ 의혹으로 당에서 제명된 김관영 후보가 무소속으로 출마한 뒤 이 후보와 접전을 벌이자 ‘전북 사수’를 위해 총공세에 나선 것이다. 전북지사 선거 결과가 정청래 대표의 연임 도전 가능성이 있는 8월 전당대회의 변수가 될 수도 있어 민주당 내부도 촉각을 세우고 있다.)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk: "This 'Death Song' Targets Starbucks"… Democratic Party: "People Power Party Dividing People into Pro and Con Camps for Instigation" (장동혁 “이번 ‘죽창가’는 스타벅스”…민주 “국힘, 찬반 나눠 선동”)
item.description:
The People Power Party (PPP) has launched a counterattack against the criticism by President Lee Jae-myung and the ruling party, as well as the government's boycott movement targeting Starbucks for its "May 18 Tank Day" marketing, calling it a "local election-style kangaroo court" and turning the issue into a point of contention for the June 3 local elections. This is seen as an effort to rally conservative support in the final stages of the election campaign, as the PPP closes in on the Democratic Party of Korea in areas such as Seoul and the Busan-Ulsan-Gyeongnam (BUG) region. The Democratic Party of Korea is responding by accusing the PPP of using Starbucks to divide people into opposing camps and instigate conflict, hoping to attract centrist and progressive voters. (국민의힘이 ‘5·18 탱크데이’ 마케팅을 벌인 스타벅스를 이재명 대통령과 여당이 비판하고 정부가 불매 움직임에 나선 것에 대해 “지방선거용 인민재판”이라고 맞불을 놓으며 6·3 지방선거 쟁점화에 나섰다. 서울과 부·울·경(부산·울산·경남) 등에서 더불어민주당을 바짝 추격하는 흐름이 형성되자 선거 막판 보수 지지층 결집에 나선 것으로 해석된다. 더불어민주당은 “국민의힘이 스타벅스로 찬반 편을 나눠 선동하고 있다”고 대응하면서 중도·진보층 결집을 기대하는 분위기다.)

PPP leader Jang Dong-hyuk said during a central election committee meeting at the party's headquarters in Yeouido, Seoul, on the 25th: "This time, the target of the 'death song' is Starbucks. The Starbucks boycott is effective only until June 3. After that day, Lee Jae-myung, the Democratic Party, and the 'Daughters of Reform' will all carry Starbucks coffee as if nothing ever happened." This was a sweeping criticism comparing the controversy over Starbucks's disparagement of the May 18 Gwangju Democratization Movement and the resulting boycott movement to the boycott of Japanese products during the Moon Jae-in administration in response to Japan's unilateral export restrictions on semiconductor materials. (장동혁 국민의힘 대표는 25일 서울 여의도 당사에서 중앙선거대책위원회의를 열어 “이번 ‘죽창가’ 대상은 스타벅스”라며 “스타벅스 불매운동 기한은 딱 6월3일까지다. 이재명, 민주당, 개딸들 모두 그날만 지나면 무슨 일 있었냐는 듯 스타벅스 커피를 들고 다닐 것”이라고 말했다. 스타벅스의 5·18 광주민주화운동 폄훼 논란과 그에 따른 불매 움직임을 문재인 정부 당시 일본 정부의 일방적인 반도체 소재 수출규제 조처에 반발해 벌어진 일본 상품 불매운동에 빗대 싸잡아 비판한 것이다.)

Jang urged: "This Friday (29th), when early voting takes place, let the people clearly show the will of free citizens: 'I choose my own coffee.' This election is a showdown between Lee Jae-myung and the 'Daughters of Reform' versus free citizens." By this, he defined citizens participating in the criticism and boycott of Starbucks as supporters of President Lee Jae-myung's hardline base—the "Daughters of Reform" (a term used for reform-minded followers)—and those opposing the boycott as "free citizens." (장 대표는 “(사전투표가 있는) 이번 금요일(29일) 국민들께서 ‘내 커피는 내가 고른다’는 자유시민 의지를 확실하게 보여주자”며 “이번 선거는 이재명·개딸과 자유시민의 대결”이라고 했다. 스타벅스 비판·불매에 동참하는 시민을 민주당 대표 시절 이재명 대통령의 강성 지지층인 ‘개딸’(개혁의 딸)로, 이에 반대하는 이들을 ‘자유시민’으로 규정한 것이다.)

Floor leader Song Un-seok also said: "Recently, ahead of the elections, President Lee Jae-myung's social media politicking, including targeting Starbucks and Musinsa, has been running rampant. The president should immediately cease election interference and focus on caring for the people's livelihood and the economy." (송언석 원내대표도 “최근 선거를 앞두고 스타벅스·무신사 저격 등 이재명 대통령의 사회관계망서비스(SNS) 정치가 폭주하고 있다”며 “대통령은 선거 개입을 즉각 중단하고 민생 경제 돌보는 데 전념하라”고 했다.)

The PPP believes that turning Starbucks into an election issue will not only rally conservative support but also help win over centrist voters. A party official told *The Hankyoreh*: "We aim to criticize the fact that the president and government have directly orchestrated a state-led boycott, and that President Lee is intervening in the elections to divert public attention from the various controversies surrounding Democratic Party candidates. Even among centrists, there are reactions questioning whether the government and ruling party's response is excessive." (국민의힘은 스타벅스 선거 쟁점화가 보수층 결집뿐 아니라 중도층 포섭에도 도움이 될 것이라고 보고 있다. 당 관계자는 한겨레에 “대통령과 정부가 직접 나선 관제 불매운동이 잘못됐다는 점과 이 대통령이 민주당 후보들의 여러 논란으로부터 국민 시선을 돌리려는 선거 개입을 비판하려는 것”이라며 “중도층에서도 정부·여당 대응이 과한 것 아니냐는 반응이 있다”고 했다.)

The Democratic Party maintains that its criticism of Starbucks is a commonsense measure to curb the disparagement and distortion of the May 18 events, and it appears reluctant to respond individually to the attacks from Jang and the PPP. (민주당은 스타벅스 비판은 5·18 폄훼와 왜곡에 제동을 걸기 위한 상식적인 조처라는 입장으로 장 대표와 국민의힘의 공세에 일일이 대응하지 않겠다는 분위기다.)

Democratic Party Secretary-General Jo Seung-rae said at a press briefing at the National Assembly: "What's wrong with sounding an alarm against repeated acts that undermine common sense, values, historical perspectives, and judgment criteria, and calling for measures to prevent recurrence? Isn't it the PPP that is instigating people by dividing them into pro and con camps around Starbucks and urging people to bring Starbucks to the polling stations? Using this issue for election purposes is the doing of Chairman Jang and the PPP." One Democratic Party lawmaker remarked: "I'm not sure whether this issue will become a focal point in the local elections." (조승래 민주당 사무총장은 이날 국회 기자간담회에서 “국민 상식 수준에서 가치관, 역사관, 판단 기준을 흩트려놓는 반복적인 행위에 대해 경종을 울리고 ‘재발 방지 조치가 필요하다’는 얘기가 뭐가 문제되나. 오히려 국민의힘 일각에서 스타벅스를 중심으로 찬반 편을 나눠 투표장에 스타벅스를 가져가자는 등 선동하고 있지 않냐”며 “이 문제를 선거에 이용하는 것은 장 대표와 국민의힘”이라고 했다. 민주당 한 의원은 “이 사안이 지방선거 쟁점이 될지 모르겠다”고 했다.)

Within the Democratic Party, there is a view that the PPP's offensive on Starbucks may backfire, having a negative impact on conservative consolidation and instead rallying centrist and progressive voters to the Democratic Party. Another Democratic Party lawmaker said: "In Seoul, we need to reduce the number of people voting for Oh Se-hoon (PPP candidate) in Gangnam. People with common sense wouldn't want to be lumped in with that side (far-right), right? There will certainly be an effect of rallying our supporters." (민주당 내부에선 국민의힘의 스타벅스 공세가 오히려 보수층 결집에 부정적인 영향을 끼치고, 중도·진보층의 민주당 결집 효과가 있을 것이라는 시각도 있다. 민주당 다른 의원은 “서울은 강남에서 오세훈 (국민의힘) 후보 찍는 사람을 줄여야 하는데, 상식 있는 사람들은 그쪽(극우)으로 묶이기 싫지 않겠나”라며 “우리 지지자 결집 효과도 분명히 있을 것”이라고 말했다.)

item.title: Kim Sang-wook and Kim Jong-hoon’s Ulsan Mayoral Candidate Unification Hits Rocky Waters Over ‘Anti-Cross-Voting Clause’ (김상욱-김종훈 울산시장 후보 단일화, ‘역선택 방지’ 암초 만났다)
item.description:
Amid the suspension of a public opinion poll primary for unifying the mayoral candidates of the Democratic Party of Korea and the Progressive Party in Ulsan, delaying the results announcement, candidates from both parties are sharpening their knives over the ‘anti-cross-voting clause.’ (더불어민주당과 진보당의 울산시장 후보 단일화 여론조사 경선이 중단돼 결과 발표 일정을 넘긴 가운데, 양당 후보들은 ‘역선택 방지 조항’을 놓고 서로에게 날을 세우고 있다.)

Democratic Party candidate Kim Sang-wook posted on Facebook on the 26th, stating, “I was unaware that the ‘anti-cross-voting clause’ was missing from the poll questions.” He added, “I entered this unification process with the sole condition and principle that it should proceed in a way that does not distort the will of democratic citizens. When I asked the responsible party about the omission, I was told it was unavoidable due to strong demands from the Progressive Party side. While it’s my fault for not directly checking the questions, I trusted that the Progressive Party would honor the principles we initially agreed upon.” (김상욱 민주당 후보는 26일 페이스북에 글을 올려 “여론조사 문항에 ‘역선택 방지 조항’이 누락돼 있다는 것을 몰랐다”고 밝혔다. 그는 “저는 이번 단일화에 임하며 ‘민주시민의 민의가 왜곡되지 않는 방식으로 단일화가 이뤄져야 한다’는 것을 유일한 조건이자 원칙으로 내걸었는데, 누락 경위를 (담당자에게) 물으니 진보당 쪽의 강력한 요구에 따라 어쩔 수 없었다는 설명을 들었다”며 “문항을 직접 확인하지 못한 점은 저의 잘못이지만, 진보당이 처음부터 합의한 원칙을 지켜줄 것으로 믿었다”고 말했다.)

He said, “The Progressive Party’s demand to omit the anti-cross-voting clause is utterly incomprehensible,” adding, “I will wait until the very end for an opportunity to come together in spirit.” (그는 “(진보당이) 역선택 방지조항 누락을 요구한 것은 도저히 이해할 수 없는 대목”이라며 “마지막까지 마음을 모을 기회를 기다리겠다”고 했다.)

Progressive Party candidate Kim Jong-hoon appeared on MBC Radio’s ‘Kim Jong-bae’s Focus’ on the same day and argued, “There was no particular objection to preventing cross-voting, so we proceeded with mutual agreement. But now, stopping the process in the middle of the primary after checking the poll results, because it seemed unfavorable, inevitably raises suspicion of foul play.” He continued, “The pollster says they didn’t notify (Candidate Kim Sang-wook’s side) about anything, and we are considering filing a request for evidence preservation to legally verify this.” (김종훈 진보당 후보는 이날 엠비씨(MBC) 라디오 ‘김종배의 시선집중’에 출연해 “특별히 역선택 방지에 어떤 이의가 없어서 서로 합의하에 진행한 것인데, 경선 도중 여론조사를 확인하고 자기한테 불리하니까 중단시킨 것으로 의심될 수밖에 없다”며 “여론조사 업체는 (김상욱 후보 쪽에) 알려주지 않았다고 얘기하고 있어, 증거보전신청을 해서 이를 법적으로 확인할 생각을 갖고 있다”고 말했다.)

He added, “I checked with the polling agency, and they responded that if the progress rate exceeds 70%, it is valid. We should just disclose that and proceed as agreed,” and “If no agreement is reached by today physically, it can only be seen as difficult (to achieve unification).” (그는 “여론조사 기관에 확인해보니 (진행율이) 70%가 넘으면 유효하다는 답을 받기도 했다. 그걸 공개하고 합의대로 하면 된다”며 “물리적으로 오늘 정도까지 협의가 이뤄지지 않으면 (단일화는) 어렵다고 볼 수밖에 없다”고 했다.)

Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr (이지은 기자 jieuny@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee: "Proceed Swiftly with the Transfer of Wartime Operational Control... Accelerate the Introduction of Nuclear Submarines" (이 대통령 “전작권 환수 신속히 진행해 주길…핵잠 도입 속도 내야”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung said on the 26th, "I hope for the seamless and swift progress of the transfer of wartime operational control (OPCON), which will drive the healthy development of the South Korea-U.S. alliance." (이재명 대통령이 26일 “한-미 동맹의 건강한 발전을 견인할 전작권(전시작전통제권) 환수를 차질없이 신속하게 진행해주길 바란다”고 말했다.)

During a cabinet meeting and emergency economic review meeting held at the presidential office (Cheong Wa Dae) that day, President Lee stated, "A strong security is a key foundation for leaping into a global super-gap economic powerhouse," as reported. He added, "While we already have sufficient capacity to defend ourselves, we must further strengthen our defense capabilities in the face of the harsh international reality of each country fending for itself and the survival of the fittest. What matters most is a firm stance that we are responsible for and will protect our own security." President Lee noted, "Only with a will for independent defense can our friends respect us, and our alliance remain more robust." (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의 겸 비상경제점검회의에서 “튼튼한 안보는 글로벌 초격차 경제 강국으로 도약하기 위한 핵심적 토대”라며 이렇게 말했다. 이 대통령은 “스스로 지킬 역량이 이미 충분하지만, 각자도생과 약육강식의 냉엄한 국제현실에 맞서 국방력을 한층 강화해야 한다”며 “무엇보다 중요한 것은 우리 안보는 우리 스스로 책임지고 지키겠다는 견고한 자세”라고 했다. 이 대통령은 “자주적 국방 의지가 있어야 친구도 우리를 존중하고, 동맹도 더욱 굳건하게 유지될 수 있다”고 말했다.)

President Lee announced plans to accelerate the introduction of nuclear-powered submarines. "We must hasten the transition to a future-oriented, advanced strong military," he said. "We need to speed up the adoption of artificial intelligence and drone technologies, and expedite the introduction of nuclear submarines, which are key strategic assets for future defense capabilities." (이 대통령은 핵추진잠수함 도입에 속도를 내겠다고 밝혔다. 이 대통령은 “미래형 첨단 강군으로 전환을 서둘러야 한다”며 “인공지능과 드론기술 도입을 가속화하고 미래 국방력의 핵심 전략 자산인 핵잠 도입에 속도를 내야 한다”고 말했다.)

President Lee continued, "Through the continuous expansion of research and development budgets, localization of key components, and strengthening public-private cooperation, we must pool national efforts to foster K-defense, the backbone of advanced defense." He added, "We should also accelerate the development of future new security innovation companies that will lead the global market in fields such as robotics, drones, and space." (이 대통령은 이어 “연구개발 예산의 지속적 확대와 핵심 부품 국산화, 민관협력 체계 강화를 통해 첨단 국방 근간인 케이(K)-방산 육성에 국가 역량을 모아야 한다”며 “로봇과 드론, 우주 등 분야에서 세계 시장을 선도할 미래 신 안보혁신기업 육성에도 박차를 가해야 한다”고 말했다.)

President Lee also stated, "Beyond military strength, we will solidly build a close multilateral security network through national-interest-focused pragmatic diplomacy." He emphasized, "While winning wars is important, efforts to build peace to prevent wars from occurring are also very crucial." (이 대통령은 또 “군사력에 더해 국익중심 실용외교로 긴밀한 다자 안보 네트워크를 견고하게 구축하겠다”며 “전쟁에서 이기는 것도 중요하지만, 전쟁이 나지 않도록 평화를 구축하는 노력도 매우 중요하다”고 말했다.)

By Seo Youngji yj@hani.co.kr and Shim Woosam wu32@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr 심우삼 기자 wu32@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee Says, "Foreigners Selling Stocks and Exchanging for Dollars Causes High Exchange Rate... It Will Stop When Stock Prices Stabilize" (이 대통령 “외국인 주식 팔고 환전해 고환율…주가 안정 때 멈추겠네”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung on the 26th prominently cited foreign selling and dollar conversion demand following the sharp rise in the KOSPI as a key factor behind the high exchange rate. (이재명 대통령이 26일 고환율 배경과 관련해 코스피 급등에 따른 외국인 매도·환전 수요를 주요하게 언급했다.)

During a State Council meeting and emergency economic review held at the presidential office, President Lee stated, "The exchange rate has now exceeded 1,500 won in the foreign exchange market," adding, "One major reason seems to be that foreigners are selling stocks and converting them into dollars, creating significant demand." He then asked Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Economy and Finance Koo Yoon-cheol, "Since the Korean stock market has roughly tripled, that means the valuation gains on foreign-held stocks have tripled as well, and foreigners adjusting their weight has driven up the exchange rate, right?" (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의 겸 비상경제점검회의에서 “지금 외환시장에서 (환율이) 1500원이 넘었다”며 “주요 원인 중 하나가 주식시장에서 외국인이 주식을 팔아서 그걸 달러로 바꿔 나가는 수요가 꽤 있을 거 같다”고 말했다. 그러면서 이 대통령은 구윤철 부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관에게 “한국의 주식시장이 3배 정도 올랐다는 건, 외국인 보유 주식의 평가이익이 3배 정도 올랐다는 얘기고, 그래서 외국인이 비중 조정하느라 (환율이 오른) 거죠?”라고 물었다.)

Deputy Prime Minister Koo responded, "Because the stock prices are so strong, foreigners have sold about 110 trillion won worth of Korean assets due to higher valuations," adding, "As they sell, dollar demand increases, temporarily pushing the exchange rate above 1,500 won." In response, President Lee noted, "The current account surplus is increasing," and Deputy Prime Minister Koo said, "Even with a current account surplus, the rise in foreign asset valuations has led to some selling, and the resulting increase in dollar conversion demand is seen as the primary factor behind the exchange rate hike." President Lee replied, "If stock prices stabilize, the high exchange rate will stop." (구 부총리는 “지금 주가가 워낙 좋아, 외인(외국인 투자자)들이 한국자산 평가액이 높아지니까 110조원 정도 팔았다”며 “(외국인 투자자들이) 팔다 보니까 달러 수요가 증가하고, 그래서 일시적으로 외환시장이 1500원을 넘어서는 상황”이라고 답했다. 이에 이 대통령은 “경상수지 흑자 폭은 늘어나고 있다”고 짚었고, 구 부총리는 “경상 흑자임에도 외국인들 자산 평가도 높아지니까 일부 매각하고, 그 과정에서 달러 환전 수요가 늘어난 게 (환율 상승의) 가장 큰 요인으로 파악한다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 “주가가 안정되면 (고환율은) 멈추겠네”라고 답했다.)

President Lee's mention of the current account surplus appears aimed at confirming whether the rise in the exchange rate, despite favorable dollar inflow conditions for the Korean economy, is due to temporary factors like foreign selling and dollar conversion demand rather than structural issues. (이 대통령이 경상수지 흑자를 언급한 것은 한국 경제의 달러 유입 여건은 나쁘지 않은데도 환율이 오르는 이유가 구조적 문제보다 외국인 매도·환전 수요 같은 일시적 요인인지를 확인하려는 취지로 보인다.)

Earlier, on the 24th, Presidential Policy Chief Kim Yong-beom also commented on Facebook regarding the high exchange rate phenomenon, stating, "Unlike during the foreign exchange crisis, this is not due to a shortage of foreign currency," and "This year, the KOSPI surged over 70%, doubling the valuation of foreign-held domestic stocks to 2,600 trillion won, and the unprecedented foreign selling and resulting dollar conversion demand pushed up the exchange rate." (앞서 김용범 청와대 정책실장도 지난 24일 페이스북에 고환율 현상과 관련해 “외환위기 당시와 같이 외화 부족에서 비롯된 것이 아니다”라며 “금년 코스피가 70% 이상 급등해 외국인 보유 국내 주식 평가액이 2600조원으로 두 배가 됐고, 전례 없는 외국인 매도세에 따른 환전 수요가 환율을 밀어 올린 것”이라고 말했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Rapidly Pursue Additional Relocation of Public Institutions and Enterprises to the Southeastern Region" (이 대통령 “동남권에 추가 공공기관·기업 이전 신속하게 추진”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 26th, "To propel the southeastern region into a world-class maritime economic zone, we must also swiftly pursue the additional relocation of other public institutions and enterprises that have been under consideration for a long time." (이재명 대통령이 26일 “동남권을 세계적인 해양경제구역으로 도약시키기 위해 오래 전부터 검토됐던 다른 공공기관이나 기업 추가 이전도 신속하게 추진해야겠다”고 말했다.)

President Lee made these remarks during a Cabinet meeting combined with an emergency economic review meeting held at the Presidential Office in Cheong Wa Dae, saying, "Amid rapid changes in the international order and accelerated supply chain restructuring, securing a lead in global maritime dominance has become more crucial than ever. In this regard, the southeastern region, with its excellent manufacturing ecosystem, logistics infrastructure, and robust hinterland, possesses ample potential to grow into a world-class maritime economic zone." (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의 겸 비상경제점검회의에서 “국제질서의 급변, 공급망 재편 가속으로 글로벌 해양주도권 선점이 그 어느 때보다 중요한 과제가 됐다. 이와 관련해 우수한 제조업 생태계와 물류 인프라, 탄탄한 배후지를 갖춘 동남권은 세계적인 해양 경제권으로 성장할 수 있는 충분한 잠재력을 가지고 있는 지역”이라며 이렇게 말했다.)

President Lee continued, "As competition for maritime dominance in Northeast Asia intensifies, the geopolitical value of the southeastern region will shine even brighter. To achieve this, we must continue strategic investments in the southeastern region steadily. Following the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries, the relocation of HMM (Hyundai Merchant Marine) has also been confirmed." (이 대통령은 이어 “동북아의 해양 주도권 경쟁이 치열해지는 과정에서 동남권의 지정학적 가치가 더욱더 빛을 발하게 될 것”이라며 “이를 위해 동남권에 대한 전략적 투자를 꾸준하게 이어 나가야겠다. 해양수산부에 이어 에이치엠엠(HMM) 이전도 확정됐다”고 말했다.)

Furthermore, President Lee stated, "We must also complete tasks such as establishing a new investment corporation for the southeastern region, expanding port and aviation infrastructure, and strengthening the maritime industry foundation. I will do my utmost to ensure that the southeastern region transforms into a hub of the eastern maritime capital zone, serving as an icebreaker that pioneers balanced national development and a future as a maritime powerhouse." (아울러 이 대통령은 “동남권 투자공사 신설, 항만 항공 인프라 확충, 해양산업 기반 강화 같은 과제도 완수해야 한다”며 “동남권이 동부해양수도권 중심으로 거듭나 국토 균형발전과 해양강국 미래를 개척하는 쇄빙선이 될 수 있도록 최선을 다하겠다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: "Go Ha Jung-woo!" Shin Dong-wook Targets Han Dong-hoon's Camp: "Can't Even Cheer a Rival Candidate?" (“하정우 파이팅” 신동욱, 한동훈 쪽 겨냥 “경쟁후보 격려도 못 하나”)
item.description:
Shin Dong-wook, a lawmaker from the People Power Party (PPP), met Ha Jung-woo, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for the Busan Buk-gu Gap by-election, and said "Go Ha Jung-woo!" This sparked a verbal clash after Han Dong-hoon, the independent candidate for the same district, expressed opposition. In response, Lawmaker Shin explained again, "This candidate (Ha) is running for election for the first time, so I felt a bit sorry for him. It was meant as an encouragement for a rival candidate." (신동욱 국민의힘 의원이 하정우 더불어민주당 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거 후보를 만나 “하정우 화이팅”이라고 말한 것을 두고 한동훈 무소속 부산 북갑 후보 쪽에서 반발하며 설전이 벌어진 가운데, 신 의원이 “선거를 처음 치르는 분(하 후보)이라 안쓰러운 마음도 있었다”며 “경쟁 후보로서 격려해 준 것”이라고 재차 설명했다.)

In an interview on CBS Radio's "Park Sung-tae's News Show" on the 26th, when the host asked, "Was the 'Go Ha Jung-woo' comment a friendly gesture?", Shin replied, "When you meet a rival candidate, who goes around insulting, cursing, and spitting, no matter the election?" He added, "There are even photos of Han himself meeting Ha, shaking hands, and walking through the district saying 'Good luck' and 'Take care of your health.'" (신 의원은 26일 시비에스(CBS) 라디오 ‘박성태의 뉴스쇼’와 인터뷰에서 “‘하정우 화이팅’ 발언은 덕담인가”라고 진행자가 묻자 “상대 후보를 만날 때 아무리 선거지만 비난하고 욕하고 침 뱉고 지나가나”라며 “한 후보 본인도 하 후보를 만나 ‘파이팅 하십시오’, ‘건강 잘 챙기십시오’ 하면서 손잡고 지역구를 걸어가는 장면이 다 찍혀있다”고 말했다.)

On the 22nd, while campaigning for Park Min-shik, the PPP candidate for Busan Buk-gu Gap, Shin ran into Ha Jung-woo at a restaurant and greeted him with "Go Ha Jung-woo, this is Shin Dong-wook." In response, Bae Hyun-jin, a PPP lawmaker aligned with Han Dong-hoon, criticized on the same day, "One might misunderstand that the Jang Dong-hyuk leadership went to push for a 'Ha Jung-woo-Park Min-shik' unification. I hope they come back to Seoul." Han also attacked on Facebook the same day, saying, "The Jang Dong-hyuk faction might as well openly support Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo. Voting for Park Min-shik is like voting for Ha Jung-woo." (신 의원은 지난 22일 박민식 국민의힘 부산 북갑 후보 지원 유세 도중 한 식당에서 하정우 후보를 만나자 “하정우 화이팅, 신동욱입니다”라고 인사한 바 있다. 이를 두고 친한동훈계인 배현진 국민의힘 의원은 이날 “장동혁 지도부가 ‘하정우-박민식’ 단일화하러 간 줄 오해하겠다”며 “서울로 돌아오시길 바란다”고 비판했다. 한 후보도 같은 날 페이스북을 통해 “장동혁 당권파는 그냥 하정우 민주당 후보 지지 선언하라”며 “박민식 후보 찍는 것은 민주당 하정우 후보 찍는 것”이라고 공세를 펼쳤다.)

In response to the backlash from Han's camp, Shin rebutted, "Especially since Ha is running for election for the first time, I felt a bit sorry for him. Interpreting what I said in that context as a 'Park Min-shik-Ha Jung-woo' unification frame—I want to ask, what's the reason for that?" He added, "Ha Jung-woo actually gave much more friendly words to our side than I did to him." (한 후보 쪽 반발에 대해 신 의원은 “특히 하 후보는 선거를 처음 치르는 분이어서 좀 안쓰러운 마음도 있고, 그런 마음에서 한 얘기를 ‘박민식-하정우’ 단일화 프레임으로 해석하는 것은 도대체 무슨 이유인지 묻고 싶다”고 반박했다. “저보다 하정우 후보가 저희 쪽에 훨씬 더 덕담을 많이 했다”고 덧붙이기도 했다.)

Shin had also explained the situation on Facebook on the 22nd. He wrote, "I happened to run into Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo and, feeling that he must be having a tough time in his first election, I gave him words of encouragement and a friendly 'fighting.' I didn't meet Han Dong-hoon in person, but if I had, I would have given the same kind words." Seeming aware of the backlash from Han's camp, he added, "It's rather pitiful to see people swarming like bees just to make an issue out of this. But I hope you 'fight on' for the remaining election period." (신 의원은 22일에도 페이스북을 통해 당시 상황을 설명한 바 있다. 신 의원은 “우연히 마주친 민주당 하정우 후보에게 첫 선거에 고생이 많으시겠다는 마음으로 파이팅, 덕담을 드렸다”며 “직접 뵙지는 못했지만, 한동훈 후보를 만났어도 같은 덕담을 드렸을 것”이라고 적었다. 한 후보 쪽 반발을 의식한 듯 “이슈 만들어볼 생각에 벌떼같이 달려드는 모습은 다소 딱해 보입니다만, 남은 선거 기간 끝까지 ‘파이팅’하시기 바란다”고도 했다.)

Jeon Gwang-jun, Reporter light@hani.co.kr (전광준 기자 light@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee: "If you work hard, it's abuse of power—how can we get anything done?" (이 대통령 “열심히 하면 직권남용, 이래서 뭔 일 하겠냐”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung said on the 26th, "Public officials who work hard and achieve results should be evaluated, but if working hard is called abuse of power, how can we get anything done?" (이재명 대통령이 26일 “열심히 일해서 성과를 낸 공직자들이 평가받아야 하는데, 열심히 하면 직권남용이라고 하니 이래서 뭔 일을 하겠냐”고 말했다.)

During a Cabinet meeting and emergency economic review held at the Blue House that day, President Lee stated, "The Constitution stipulates that specifically infringing on citizens' rights or imposing obligations must be done by law, but general institutional design can be handled by enforcement decrees." His remarks came during a report by Health and Welfare Minister Jeong Eun-kyung on plans to revise the Emergency Medical Act to improve emergency care for high-risk pregnant women and newborns. (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의 겸 비상경제점검회의에서 “국민의 권리를 구체적으로 침해하거나 의무부담을 설정하는 건 법률에 의해 하도록 헌법에 규정돼 있지만, 일반적인 제도 설계는 시행령으로 해도 된다”고 말했다. 이 대통령의 발언은 정은경 보건복지부 장관이 고위험 임산부와 신생아에 대한 응급의료를 개선하기 위해 응급의료법을 개정하겠다고 보고하는 과정에서 나왔다.)

President Lee said, "This might be due to liability concerns. If public officials perform their duties in accordance with the law and common sense, they should be immune unless they intentionally do something wrong. But these days, if they're constantly threatened with abuse of power charges, audits, or investigations, everyone ends up avoiding work." He added, "An obsession with needing everything to be set by law has spread across all government ministries. If we put off matters that could be handled by enforcement decrees, regulations, or local government ordinances until a law is passed, and do nothing until then, how can society progress?" (이 대통령은 “이게 일종의 책임 문제 때문에 그럴 수 있다. 공무원들이 법률과 상식에 부합하게 업무를 하면, 고의로 나쁜 짓을 하는 게 아니면 면책되는데 어느 순간 툭하면 직권남용이나 감사·수사로 처벌받고 문책 당하니 다 안하려고 한다”고 말했다. 그러면서 이 대통령은 “법으로 정하지 않으면 안 된다는 강박관념이 전 정부 부처에 퍼져있다”며 “실제로 시행령이나 규칙이나, 지방정부 조례로 될 일을 법으로 미루고 법이 정해질 때까지 안 해버리니 사회 발전이 되겠냐”고 말했다.)

President Lee called for proactive administration. "There's too much legislation. It takes too long, and the law books are getting too thick," he said. "Unless it absolutely requires a law, we should handle it within the scope of enforcement decrees or work guidelines." (이 대통령은 적극 행정을 지시했다. 이 대통령은 “입법이 너무 많다. 시간이 너무 걸리고, 법전이 너무 두꺼워지고 있다”며 “꼭 법으로 해야 되는 게 아니면 가능한 범위 내에서 시행령이나 업무지침으로 해야 한다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Ko Seong-guk: "Park Geun-hye Must Appeal to 'Eliminate Traitor Han Dong-hoon'"... Calls for Support in Busan's Buk-gu Gap (고성국 “박근혜, ‘배신자 한동훈 척결’ 호소해야”…부산 북갑 지원 촉구)
item.description:
Amid former President Park Geun-hye's planned nationwide campaign to support candidates of the People Power Party in the June 3 local elections, far-right YouTuber Ko Seong-guk, who advocates for 'Yoon Again,' stated that former President Park "must go to Busan's Buk-gu Gap." Ko referred to Han Dong-hoon, an independent candidate in the Buk-gu Gap by-election for the National Assembly, as a 'traitor' and argued that with former President Park's power, "the history of betrayal must be corrected." (박근혜 전 대통령이 6·3 지방선거 국민의힘 후보 지원을 위한 전국구 광폭 행보를 이어갈 예정인 가운데, ‘윤 어게인’을 주장하는 극우 유튜버 고성국씨가 박 전 대통령이 “부산 북갑에 꼭 가야 한다”고 말했다. 고씨는 한동훈 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거 무소속 후보를 ‘배신자’로 일컬으며 박 전 대통령의 힘으로 “배신의 역사를 바로잡아야 한다”고 주장했다.)

Ko made these remarks during his YouTube live broadcast on the 25th, saying that former President Park should participate in campaign rallies supporting Park Min-sik, the People Power Party candidate running in Buk-gu Gap. (고씨는 지난 25일 자신의 유튜브 라이브 방송에서 박 전 대통령이 부산 북갑에 출마한 박민식 국민의힘 후보 지원 유세에 나서야 한다며 이같이 말했다.)

Ko said, "Remember that when traitors impeached President Park, dragged her down, and threw her into prison, that guy Han Dong-hoon, who is now running in Buk-gu Gap, rolled up his sleeves and personally demanded a 30-year sentence." He added, "In Buk-gu Gap, candidate Park Min-sik is fighting a tough battle against the traitor Han Dong-hoon and his gang." He continued, "If President Park appears in Buk-gu Gap and appeals for the elimination of traitors, rousing the residents, it could become a historic feat of correcting the history of betrayal among the right-wing free camp through President Park's power." Ko was previously known as a member of the 'pro-Park Geun-hye faction' before his 'Yoon Again' stance. (고씨는 “배신자들이 박 대통령을 탄핵해서 끌어내리고 감옥에 처박을 때 북갑에 출마한 한동훈이라는 자가 30년 구형을 하겠다며 직접 팔 걷고 나섰던 것을 기억할 것”이라며 “북갑에서 박민식 후보가 배신자 한동훈 일당과 힘겨운 싸움을 하고 있다”고 말했다. 그러면서 “박 대통령이 북갑에 나타나서 배신자 척결을 호소하면서 북갑 주민들을 일으켜 세워주는 것은 자유우파의 배신의 역사를 박 대통령의 힘으로 바로잡는 역사적 쾌거가 될 수 있다”고 덧붙였다. 고씨는 ‘윤 어게인’ 이전에는 ‘친박근혜계’ 인사로 알려졌었다.)

As Ko mentioned, candidate Han had previously, during the first trial sentencing hearing for the undue influence and abuse of power case in February 2018, requested a 30-year prison sentence for former President Park, stating, "By privatizing the president's official authority, she manipulated state affairs and undermined constitutional values." At that time, former President Yoon Suk-yeol was the head of the investigation team for the 'Park Geun-hye-Choi Soon-sil state affairs interference special counsel,' and candidate Han was seconded to the special counsel to lead key investigations. (고씨가 언급한 것처럼 한 후보는 2018년 2월 비선 실세 국정농단 사건 1심 결심 공판에서 “대통령의 직무권한을 사유화함으로써 국정을 농단하고 헌법가치를 훼손했다”며 박 전 대통령에게 징역 30년을 구형한 바 있다. 당시 ‘박근혜·최순실 국정농단 특검’ 수사팀장은 윤석열 전 대통령이었고 한 후보는 특검에 파견돼 주요 수사를 진행했다.)

However, later, in March 2024, during his tenure as chairman of the People Power Party's emergency committee, Han visited former President Park's residence in Dalseong-gun, Daegu, and had a conversation with her for about 30 minutes. After the meeting, Han told reporters, "I heard very good words about overall state affairs, current issues, and stories of her life." (다만 이후 한 후보는 국민의힘 비상대책위원장 시절인 2024년 3월 대구 달성군에 있는 박 전 대통령 자택을 찾아 박 전 대통령과 30분가량 대화를 나눴다. 회동 뒤 한 후보는 기자들과 만나 “국정 전반과 현안들, 그리고 살아오신 얘기 등 여러 가지에 대해 굉장히 좋은 말씀을 들었다”고 했다.)

Former President Park's appearance at campaign rally sites marks the first time in nine years since her impeachment from the presidency in 2017. Park visited Daegu's Chilseong Market with People Power Party's Daegu mayoral candidate Choo Kyung-ho on the 23rd, and on the 25th, she toured the Chungcheong region to support candidates. On the 27th, she is scheduled to visit Jinju in Gyeongnam, followed by Ulsan and Busan, and on the 28th, she will visit Wonju in Gangwon. Former President Park is reportedly planning to visit Gijang Market in Busan's Gijang-gun on the afternoon of the 27th to support People Power Party's Busan mayoral candidate Park Hyung-joon. (박 전 대통령이 선거 유세 현장을 찾은 것은 2017년 대통령직에서 탄핵당한 이후 9년 만이다. 박 전 대통령은 지난 23일 추경호 국민의힘 대구시장 후보와 대구 칠성시장을 다녀왔고 25일엔 충청 지역을 돌며 후보자들을 지원했다. 오는 27일엔 경남 진주에 이어 울산과 부산을 차례로 찾고, 28일엔 강원 원주를 방문한다. 박 전 대통령은 박형준 국민의힘 부산시장 후보 등을 지원하기 위해 27일 오후 부산 기장군 기장시장을 방문할 예정인 것으로 전해졌다.)

Reporter Lee Yoo-jin yjlee@hani.co.kr (이유진 기자 yjlee@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee: "For Potential Growth Rate to Rise, All Sectors and People Must Change" (이 대통령 “잠재성장률 우상향하려면 모든 분야·사람이 바뀌어야”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 26th, "I urge meticulous and swift policy responses based on the active role of fiscal policy so that this year becomes the first year of a rebound in the potential growth rate." (이재명 대통령이 26일 “올해가 잠재성장률 반등의 원년이 되도록 재정의 적극적 역할을 바탕으로 치밀하고 속도감 있는 정책 대응을 당부드린다”고 말했다.)

Speaking at a Cabinet meeting and emergency economic review held at the Blue House, President Lee said, "Despite difficult external conditions such as the prolonged Middle East war, the economy is recovering and growing rapidly, with observations that this year's nominal growth rate could approach 10%." He added, "We need to meticulously establish the economic strategy for the second half of the year reflecting these changed circumstances," and "We must focus primarily on price stability, proactively prepare for changes following the Middle East war, and proceed in earnest with structural reforms such as alleviating polarization." (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의 겸 비상경제점검회의에서 “중동전쟁 장기화 등 대외여건 어려움에도 경제가 빠르게 회복하고 성장하면서 올해 명목 성장률이 10% 육박할 수 있다는 관측이 나온다”며 이렇게 말했다. 이 대통령은 “이처럼 달라진 상황을 반영해서 하반기 경제전략을 세밀하게 수립해야 한다”며 “물가안정에 최우선으로 주력하고 중동전쟁 이후 상황변화에도 선제적으로 대비해야 한다”, “양극화 완화 등 구조개혁도 본격적으로 진행해야 한다”고 했다.)

President Lee also said, "We must drastically cut unnecessary fiscal spending," and "It is our responsibility to properly use the taxes and power entrusted by the people solely for the people." (이 대통령은 또 “불요불급한 재정지출을 과감하게 줄여야 한다”며 “국민이 맡긴 세금과 권력을 오로지 국민만을 위해서 제대로 잘 사용하는 게 우리의 책임”이라고 말했다.)

Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Finance and Economy Koo Yoon-cheol stated at the meeting, "The direction of the economic implementation strategy for the second half of the year is to maintain an active fiscal stance to minimize the impact of the Middle East war, stabilize living prices and livelihoods directly related to people's daily lives, and proactively respond to risks," and "We plan to report to the President around the end of June regarding the economic growth strategy for the second half of the year." (구윤철 부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관은 이날 회의에서 “하반기 경제추진전략 추진 방향은 중동전쟁의 영향을 하반기에도 최소화하기 위해 적극적 재정 기조를 유지하고, 서민들의 민생과 직결되는 생활물가·민생안정, 선제적 리스크 대응 등을 하겠다”며 “6월 말께 대통령에게 (하반기 경제성장전략에 대해) 보고할 예정”이라고 말했다.)

President Lee said, "It is important to enable the potential growth rate to continuously rise," and "With the current inertia and methods, it will inevitably decline. To rise, everyone in all fields must change." (이 대통령은 “지속적으로 (잠재성장률을) 우상향할 수 있게 하는 게 중요하다”며 “지금과 같은 관성과 방식으로는 결국 우하향할 수밖에 없다. 우상향하려면 모든 분야에서 모든 사람이 바뀌어야 한다”고 말했다.)
